papers.title: S1Arena-MM: Which Multimodal Decisions Can Be Left to System 1?
papers.abstract: Perception systems often make discrete decisions: flag a hateful meme, predict whether a pedestrian will cross, detect a spoofed voice, or select the next move in a game. System-1 models, such as OneJev and Jev-Omni, read the media and return probabilities over the options in a single forward pass, while multimodal large language models (MLLMs) generate text. Which multimodal decisions can System-1 models handle, and where do MLLMs perform better? We introduce S1Arena-MM, a benchmark that gives every model the same decision requests and scores the probabilities it returns. It contains 51,060 questions across 94 tasks with image, video, and audio input, drawn from 94 public datasets and three program-generated ones. It also includes 102 closed-loop game environments that a model plays from screenshots; in real-time mode, the game continues while the model decides. We evaluate 33 open models: 12 System-1 models and 21 MLLMs read at the answer token. On static decisions, the best System-1 model leads the best MLLM by 4.9 percentage points on images and is within one point of it on video and audio. Post-training for decisions mainly improves the probabilities: on video, a System-1 model has a lower Brier score than the MLLM that it is post-trained from in 10 of 12 pairs. With up to 2,048 thought tokens per question, the most accurate MLLMs pass the best System-1 models only slightly, and thinking raises the Brier score of most MLLMs. Closed loops separate the models: three System-1 models built on a 27B MLLM reach 22.0-33.3% progression in BALROG, and no other model exceeds 9.7% with thinking off. In real-time GameWorld, latencies of up to 1.1 s per decision cause no measurable loss of progress for System-1 models. Code and data: https://github.com/zhaoyang02/S1Arena-MM.

ai_summary.problem: 需要判断哪些多模态离散决策可以由System-1模型处理，哪些仍更适合多模态大语言模型（MLLM），但目前缺乏统一、可比较的评测基准。
ai_summary.method: 提出S1Arena-MM基准，为所有模型提供相同决策请求并对其返回概率评分，覆盖51,060个问题、94个任务及图像/视频/音频输入，并包含102个闭环游戏环境；评测33个开源模型，其中12个System-1模型和21个MLLM。
ai_summary.result: 静态决策中最佳System-1模型在图像上领先最佳MLLM 4.9个百分点，在视频和音频上差距不超过1个百分点；thinking仅使最准确MLLM略超最佳System-1且多数情况下恶化Brier分数；闭环游戏中System-1模型显著领先，BALROG进度达22.0-33.3%，其他模型关闭thinking时不超过9.7%，实时延迟至1.1秒无明显进度损失。
ai_summary.novelty: 构建了统一概率评分、覆盖多模态静态任务与实时闭环游戏的大规模基准，系统比较System-1模型与MLLM的多模态决策能力。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态决策场景中System-1模型与MLLM的选型、后训练策略及实时Agent设计提供了量化依据。

papers.title: What Should World Models Plan Over? Learning Geometry-Aligned Representations of Body Motion
papers.abstract: We introduce MotionPort, which learns low-dimensional latent representations of body motion for accurate dynamics prediction and effective long-horizon planning. Existing world-model planners often search over action representations learned for prediction, yet we show that predictive accuracy alone does not ensure that optimization can discover successful trajectories. MotionPort addresses this mismatch by representing body trajectories rather than action chunks and organizing the search space by motion similarity, helping predicted improvements translate into successful execution. Without fine-tuning state encoders, MotionPort raises average goal-reaching success from 37.9% to 87.8% across three backbones and seven settings in four domains. On the evaluated AntMaze-OGBench tasks, it achieves 72% success, compared with 4% for the strongest baseline.

ai_summary.problem: 现有世界模型规划器通常在与预测学习相匹配的动作表示空间中进行搜索，但仅靠预测准确并不能保证优化能找到成功轨迹，导致规划性能受限。
ai_summary.method: 提出 MotionPort，学习身体运动的低维潜在表示，并直接在身体轨迹表示而非动作块上进行规划；同时按运动相似性组织搜索空间，使预测改进更容易转化为成功执行。
ai_summary.result: 在不微调状态编码器的情况下，MotionPort 在四个领域、七种设置和三个骨干网络上将平均目标到达成功率从 37.9% 提升到 87.8%；在 AntMaze-OGBench 上达到 72% 成功率，而最强基线仅 4%。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是让世界模型的规划空间与身体运动的几何结构对齐，而不是单纯依赖为预测学习的动作表示。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作表明世界模型规划中“规划什么表示”至关重要，为提升长时程规划与具身智能决策提供了新思路。
ai_summary.org: University of Massachusetts Amherst (UMass Amherst)

papers.title: CarlHOI: Counterfactual Predictive Imagination for Generalizable Multi-Humanoid Object Interaction under Constrained Environments
papers.abstract: Recent advances in physics-based humanoid control enable teams of varying sizes to coordinate their movements and cooperatively transport shared objects. However, adapting learned cooperative behaviors to unseen environmental constraints remains challenging, particularly when obstacles require coordinated detours and changes in team configuration. We propose CarlHOI, a counterfactual predictive imagination framework built upon a counterfactual-anchored relational latent world model (CarlWM) for human-object interaction (HOI), enabling multi-humanoid teams to adapt to unseen environmental constraints without retraining their underlying cooperative control policies. CarlHOI explicitly represents the shared object, individual humanoids, and environmental obstacles as interacting entities. Trained offline using counterfactual simulator rollouts, the model imagines alternative collective futures under different shared waypoint commands, predicting how the coupled humanoid team and object would respond. By evaluating these imagined outcomes through predicted progress, failure, and contact risks, and long-horizon value estimates, CarlHOI selects adaptive guidance commands while preserving the pretrained cooperative controller. We introduce a benchmark comprising three challenging obstacle-constrained transport tasks to evaluate adaptation and generalization. Despite being trained exclusively with four humanoids, our model generalizes without retraining to teams of two to ten humanoids, unseen obstacle geometries and placements, unseen objects, and novel combinations of environmental constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved cooperative transport success over evaluated baselines across diverse configurations. Results highlight the potential of counterfactual predictive imagination to extend pretrained multi-humanoid cooperative skills beyond their original training conditions.

ai_summary.problem: 多类人机器人团队在障碍约束环境下协同搬运共享物体时，预训练协作控制策略难以适应未见过的环境约束与队形变化。
ai_summary.method: 提出CarlHOI框架，基于反事实锚定的关系潜世界模型CarlWM，将共享物体、个体类人机器人和障碍建模为交互实体；通过离线反事实模拟器数据训练，在不同共享路点指令下想象团队与物体的耦合未来，并依据进展、失败、接触风险与长时价值选择自适应引导指令。
ai_summary.result: 在三个障碍约束搬运任务上，CarlHOI无需重新训练底层协作控制器即可提升协同搬运成功率，并能从四机器人训练泛化到二至十机器人、未见障碍、未见物体及新约束组合。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是用反事实预测想象为预训练多类人机器人协作策略提供在线自适应引导，而不重训底层控制策略。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了世界模型与反事实想象在提升多智能体具身协作策略泛化性方面的潜力。

papers.title: JEPA-Shield: Safe Diffusion Planning with Latent World Models via Conformal Shielding
papers.abstract: Latent world models enable planning from images, but their predictions do not directly establish whether a robot will satisfy physical constraints. We present JEPA-Shield, which connects a frozen action-conditioned Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world model to task-space safety enforcement. Two downstream models predict relative motion from imagined latent rollouts and decode unsafe geometry from the current image. Split conformal prediction turns end-to-end motion-prediction errors into multi-horizon uncertainty tubes. A backup-based shield checks these tubes against physical constraints and screens both candidate trajectories and final proposals in diffusion-inspired sampling-based model predictive control. Under the stated exchangeability and initial-backup assumptions, we establish probabilistic constraint satisfaction at action-block boundaries for a returned plan executed without replanning. We also introduce VParkBench, with geometric car and tractor-trailer parking tasks and a editable photorealistic Gaussian-splatting environment. In closed-loop evaluation, JEPA-Shield achieves success rates of 84.4%, 82.3%, and 99.0%, respectively, with no observed constraint violations. Ablations show complementary benefits from shielding and uncertainty calibration. The results demonstrate the importance of grounding latent world-model predictions in task-space quantities and explicitly accounting for prediction uncertainty in safety-critical planning.

ai_summary.problem: 潜在世界模型可用于从图像进行规划，但其预测本身不能直接保证机器人满足物理约束，安全关键规划中缺乏可靠的任务空间安全校验。
ai_summary.method: 提出 JEPA-Shield，将冻结的动作条件 JEPA 世界模型与任务空间安全约束连接起来：用两个下游模型从想象潜在 rollout 预测相对运动、从当前图像解码不安全几何，并用 split conformal prediction 将端到端运动预测误差转化为多步不确定性管；随后用基于备份的 shield 检查这些管是否满足物理约束，并在扩散启发式采样 MPC 中筛选候选轨迹与最终方案。
ai_summary.result: 在闭环评估中，JEPA-Shield 在 VParkBench 的几何泊车任务上分别达到 84.4%、82.3% 和 99.0% 的成功率，且未观察到约束违反；消融显示 shielding 与不确定性校准具有互补收益。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是将 conformal 不确定性校准与备份式 shielding 结合，把潜在世界模型的想象预测落地为任务空间安全约束，用于扩散式采样 MPC 的安全筛选。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明在安全关键的具身智能与基于世界模型的规划中，必须将潜在预测 grounding 到任务空间量并显式建模预测不确定性。

papers.title: Rethinking Closed-Ended Medical VLM Evaluation: From Stable Wrongness to Counterfactual Answer Sensitivity
papers.abstract: As medical VLMs are increasingly evaluated for clinical decision-support scenarios, knowing when to trust their predictions is critical. Closed-ended medical VQA has become a common benchmark format because it enables automated scoring. Yet, systematic investigation into whether this format changes the reliability problem remains scarce. We identify a failure mode that we call stable wrongness: models can produce incorrect yes/no answers that remain confident and repeatable even when patient-specific visual evidence is removed or mismatched. This failure violates the premise behind sampling-stability uncertainty methods, including recent hallucination-aware calibration (HAC) variants: disagreement is informative only when errors are unstable. When shortcut-driven errors are themselves stable, sampling agreement can remain deceptively high. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce Counterfactual Answer Sensitivity (CAS), which shifts reliability estimation from answer stability to evidence sensitivity. CAS uses cross-modal counterfactual interventions, such as text-only, black, and corrupted images, to audit whether a committed yes/no answer remains supported when visual evidence is invalidated. Across 7 VLMs and 3 benchmarks, CAS outperforms the best HAC-family scores across all evaluated settings, achieving a macro-averaged AUROC gain of +0.150 for error detection. Mechanistic analysis further shows that CAS recovers hidden errors in the HAC-confident region and that its strongest standalone signal is counterfactual decision-boundary shift rather than hard prediction stability. Our findings suggest that closed-ended evaluation should test visual dependence, not only answer stability, in safety-critical medical contexts.

ai_summary.problem: 闭式医学视觉问答（VQA）评估中，模型可能产生自信且可重复的错误答案（stable wrongness），即使患者相关视觉证据被移除或不匹配，现有基于采样稳定性的不确定性方法会失效。
ai_summary.method: 提出反事实答案敏感性（CAS），通过文本-only、全黑图像、损坏图像等跨模态反事实干预，检验模型已给出的是/否答案在视觉证据失效时是否仍受支持，从而将可靠性估计从答案稳定性转向证据敏感性。
ai_summary.result: 在7个VLM和3个基准上，CAS在所有设置中优于最佳HAC系列方法，错误检测宏平均AUROC提升+0.150，并能找回HAC高置信区域中的隐藏错误。
ai_summary.novelty: 将医学VLM可靠性评估从“答案采样稳定性”转向“对视觉证据的反事实敏感性”，揭示并利用稳定错误模式。
ai_summary.relevance: 对安全关键医疗场景中的多模态模型评估具有直接意义，表明闭式评测应检验视觉依赖性而非仅看答案稳定性。

papers.title: Representation Alignment Is Only as Good as the Teacher's Behavioral Structure
papers.abstract: Recent works align the intermediate features of vision-language-action (VLA) models with frozen vision encoders during fine-tuning, hoping to inject additional priors such as 3D awareness or affordances. Unlike in image generation, where teachers for representation alignment (REPA) are assessed with encoder-intrinsic metrics, teachers for VLAs are still chosen largely by heuristics. We show that this practice is unreliable: across 14 teachers and 16 manipulation tasks, under matched training budgets, no off-the-shelf vision encoder improves the clean success rate of $π_{0.5}$ by more than 1 point, and all of them reduce its success rate under perturbations by 10 to 39 points. Neither global semantics nor spatial structure, the criteria used in image generation, predicts which teachers help. We therefore propose the behavioral structure metric (BSM), which measures whether states that are close in a teacher's feature space are followed by similar expert actions within the same task. BSM correlates strongly with success rate under perturbations ($r=0.87$), and every off-the-shelf vision encoder scores below $π_{0.5}$ itself. Based on it, we introduce Behavior-Aware VLA Alignment (BAVA), a general VLA alignment protocol that favors vision encoders whose BSM exceeds the student's and stops alignment early according to the student's BSM during training. On SmolVLA, BAVA matches continuous alignment with one third of the alignment budget, and improves the average success rate by 4.6 points over unaligned fine-tuning. Our results suggest that representation alignment benefits VLAs only when the teacher encodes rich behaviorally relevant structure.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在微调时常用冻结视觉编码器做表征对齐，但教师编码器的选择主要依赖启发式，缺乏可靠标准；现有通用视觉编码器未必能提升VLA性能，甚至可能损害鲁棒性。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出行为结构度量（BSM），衡量教师特征空间中相近的状态在同一任务中是否对应相似的专家动作；并基于BSM提出Behavior-Aware VLA Alignment（BAVA）协议，优先选择BSM高于学生的视觉编码器，并在训练中根据学生BSM提前停止对齐。
ai_summary.result: 在14个教师和16个操作任务上，所有现成视觉编码器对π0.5干净成功率的提升均不超过1个点，且在扰动下降低10–39个点；BSM与扰动下成功率强相关（r=0.87）。在SmolVLA上，BAVA仅用三分之一对齐预算即可匹配持续对齐，并比未对齐微调平均提升4.6个点。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出以“行为结构”而非全局语义或空间结构来评价和指导VLA表征对齐的BSM指标及BAVA协议。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作表明VLA表征对齐只有在教师编码器包含丰富且行为相关的结构时才有效，为VLA教师选择和对齐策略提供了可操作的评估标准。

papers.title: Fill in the Blanks: Non-Autoregressive Schema-Parallel Key Information Extraction with CTC Decoding
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) extract structured data from documents by generating the requested JSON one token at a time, so their sequential steps grow with the length of the answer. Yet in key information extraction (KIE) the schema already fixes the answer's structure: keys, nesting and lists are known before decoding, and only the values are unknown. We exploit this with a non-autoregressive extractor that writes the structure from the schema, sizes every list with a count pass, and predicts all values in parallel, in a fixed number of passes that does not grow with the document. Each value is decoded with connectionist temporal classification (CTC) in its own block of slots, so its length never has to be predicted, and a value that is still open after its block gets a larger token budget. Zero-shot on VAREX, CORD and FUNSD, our 4B extractor is 3.5$\times$ faster than the diffusion-VLM competition on average (up to 5.6$\times$) and more accurate, with 4--6 forward passes per document where block diffusion needs 12--74. The same extractor also drafts for speculative decoding with its own autoregressive base: it runs 8.3$\times$ faster than autoregressive decoding (up to 10.4$\times$) within 0.4 points of its accuracy, and 3.3$\times$ faster than speculative diffusion decoding while 13.0 points more accurate. We release the model and code.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言模型在关键信息抽取（KIE）中逐 token 生成结构化 JSON，解码步数随答案长度增长，效率低；而 KIE 的 schema 已给定结构，只有字段值未知。
ai_summary.method: 提出非自回归的 schema 并行抽取器：直接按 schema 写出键、嵌套和列表结构，用一次 count pass 确定每个列表长度，并在固定轮数内并行预测所有字段值；每个值在独立 slot block 中用 CTC 解码，无需预测长度，未完成的值可扩大 token 预算。
ai_summary.result: 在 VAREX、CORD、FUNSD 零样本设置下，4B 模型平均比扩散 VLM 快 3.5 倍（最高 5.6 倍）且更准确，每文档仅需 4–6 次前向；作为投机解码草稿模型时，比自回归解码快 8.3 倍（最高 10.4 倍），精度仅差 0.4 分。
ai_summary.novelty: 利用 KIE schema 已知结构，将结构生成、列表计数和字段值 CTC 并行解码结合，实现解码轮数不随文档/答案长度增长的非自回归 KIE。
ai_summary.relevance: 为文档结构化抽取提供更高效、可并行的新范式，并可兼作投机解码草稿模型，提升 VLM 结构化输出效率。
ai_summary.org: IBM Research（以色列）

papers.title: From States to Dynamics: Detecting Rule Violations in OthelloGPT
papers.abstract: Sequence models trained on game moves have been shown to encode world models, with structured linear probes revealing the underlying game states. World models, however, are inherently dynamic: in deterministic board games, a set of rules constrain how states evolve over time. We therefore ask if and how OthelloGPT, a transformer trained only on Othello move sequences, manifests the rules of the game in its activation space. We divide the rules of Othello, and symmetrically their violations, into three classes: placing a disc on an empty square (R1), flanking an opponent's disc (R2), and moving in turn (R3). We find that linear probes accurately separate legal from illegal moves, and also distinguish between the three kinds of rule violations. We introduce an unsupervised rule-violation detector based on the step length of activations between consecutive moves, which identifies illegal moves above chance. We further improve our detection metric by computing step length in the latent space of select sparse autoencoders. Together, we find that OthelloGPT follows game rules of Othello to a large extent, and that we can detect rule violations using structured detectors on model activations.

ai_summary.problem: 论文研究仅在奥赛罗棋走子序列上训练的 OthelloGPT 是否在其激活空间中编码并遵循游戏规则，以及能否检测非法走子。
ai_summary.method: 作者将规则违反分为三类：在空位落子、未夹住对方棋子、未轮流走子；使用线性探针区分合法与非法走子及不同违规类型，并提出基于连续走子激活步长的无监督违规检测器，还在稀疏自编码器潜空间中改进检测指标。
ai_summary.result: 线性探针能准确区分合法与非法走子并识别违规类型；基于激活步长的无监督检测器能以高于随机水平识别非法走子，稀疏自编码器潜空间可进一步提升检测效果。
ai_summary.novelty: 从静态状态探测转向动态规则与规则违反检测，并提出基于激活步长及稀疏自编码器潜空间的无监督违规检测方法。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于理解序列模型内部世界模型是否掌握动态规则，并推动基于激活的模型可解释性与规则一致性检测。

papers.title: Grounded in Contact: Reducing Floating and Interpenetration Artifacts with Multimodal Skill-Effect Models
papers.abstract: Learning to predict the effects of contact-rich manipulation skills requires models that represent distinct outcome modes rather than a single expected result. Even for basic skills such as pushing, picking, and placing, small variations in contact conditions or object geometry can produce qualitatively different object motions under nearly identical states and actions. Deterministic and Gaussian models tend to average over these alternatives or represent them as a single broad distribution, obscuring distinct modes such as sliding, toppling, and rotating. We study probabilistic skill-effect models that learn multimodal distributions over object pose changes given partial point clouds and actions. We instantiate this abstraction with three representative model classes: mixture density networks, state tokenization, and flow matching, each paired with latent dynamics for next-step prediction. Across diverse objects and skills, explicitly multimodal models predict which outcome occurs more accurately than deterministic and Gaussian baselines. In planning, flow matching significantly improves task success over the deterministic baseline on every skill and achieves the highest success on every multi-step sequence. On a real robot, probabilistic models succeed at pick about twice as often as the deterministic baseline, providing evidence that probabilistic skill effects offer a practical abstraction for reasoning and planning under uncertainty.

ai_summary.problem: 在接触丰富的操作技能（推、抓、放）中，几乎相同的状态和动作会因微小接触条件或几何差异产生定性不同的结果（滑动、倾倒、旋转），而确定性模型和高斯模型会把这些多模态结果平均掉或抹平为单一宽分布，导致预测与规划失真。
ai_summary.method: 论文研究概率化的“技能效果模型”：以部分点云和动作为输入，学习物体位姿变化的多模态分布，并实例化三类代表性模型——混合密度网络（MDN）、状态 tokenization、flow matching，各自与隐动力学模型配对用于下一步预测，进而在规划与真机中评估。
ai_summary.result: 显式多模态模型在多种物体和技能上比确定性/高斯基线更准确地预测实际发生的结果模式；规划中 flow matching 在每个技能上都显著优于确定性基线，并在所有多步序列任务上取得最高成功率；真机抓取成功率约为确定性基线的两倍。
ai_summary.novelty: 系统对比三类多模态技能效果建模方式并与隐动力学结合，用实验证明显式多模态建模能在接触丰富操作中有效抑制漂浮/穿透类伪影并支撑不确定性下的推理与规划。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能中接触不确定性建模与基于模型的规划提供了可用的抽象与实证依据，对机器人世界模型研究具有参考价值。

papers.title: Dr. Grasp-RL: Diverse and Robust Dexterous Grasping via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Human interaction with physical objects relies on a combination of dexterity and robustness. In robotic manipulation, dexterity requires not only flexible end effectors but also a diverse repertoire of manipulation strategies, while robustness requires closed-loop adaptation to disturbances and unexpected situations. Two prominent research directions in dexterous grasping have largely addressed these capabilities separately. Generative approaches model multimodal distributions to produce diverse grasp poses, but their reliance on open-loop execution can limit robustness. Reinforcement learning approaches learn closed-loop grasping policies, but can converge to a narrow range of successful grasping strategies, limiting behavioral diversity. We introduce a time-reversed curriculum with a coordinated reset mechanism that enables a simple MLP policy trained with PPO to capture multiple modes of the grasp-pose distribution while maintaining closed-loop control. Experiments demonstrate both diverse grasping behaviors and robust closed-loop execution. Trained on only approximately 400 objects, our policy further demonstrates strong generalization when evaluated on more than 20,000 unseen objects.

ai_summary.problem: 如何同时实现灵巧抓取的行为多样性与闭环鲁棒性，避免生成式方法开环执行不够鲁棒、强化学习方法策略多样性不足的问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出一种时间反转课程学习与协调重置机制，使简单的MLP策略通过PPO训练即可覆盖抓取姿态分布的多个模态，同时保持闭环控制能力。
ai_summary.result: 实验表明策略具备多样化抓取行为和鲁棒闭环执行能力，仅用约400个物体训练即可在超过20000个未见物体上展现较强泛化。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过时间反转课程与协调重置机制，让简单PPO+MLP策略兼顾多模态抓取多样性与闭环鲁棒性。
ai_summary.relevance: 为灵巧抓取和机器人强化学习提供了一条同时提升策略多样性与鲁棒性的简单有效路径，对具身智能中的通用操作学习有参考价值。

papers.title: Action Windows Are Inherently Temporal: A Benchmark for Time-Sensitive Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language model (VLM) agents have surpassed learned-policy baselines on existing robotic manipulation benchmarks. However, these agents still struggle with time-sensitive everyday tasks that existing benchmarks for VLM agents cover only partially. In these tasks, evolving physical processes create finite windows for successful intervention. These action windows are inherently temporal and impose a shared time budget on decision making and physical execution. Coordinating intervention within this budget requires agents to determine when the window opens. We introduce AWAIT, a simulation benchmark that evaluates task completion within action windows while accounting for decision and execution time. Our evaluation reveals difficulties in recognizing window onset and shows that successive decisions and movements can exhaust an action window even when each decision takes less than the window duration. Project page: https://eyja42.github.io/await-site/.

ai_summary.problem: 现有机器人操作基准对时间敏感任务覆盖不足，VLM智能体难以在物理过程形成的有限动作窗口内及时干预，且未充分考虑决策与执行耗时。
ai_summary.method: 提出AWAIT仿真基准，用于评估VLM智能体在动作窗口内完成任务的能力，并将决策时间和物理执行时间共同纳入时间预算。
ai_summary.result: 实验显示智能体难以识别动作窗口开启时机；即使单次决策短于窗口时长，连续决策和移动也可能耗尽整个动作窗口。
ai_summary.novelty: 将“动作窗口”的固有时序性与决策+执行共享时间预算结合，构建专门评估时间敏感机器人操作的基准。
ai_summary.relevance: 揭示了VLM智能体在具身任务中时序推理与实时协调能力的关键缺口，推动更贴近真实物理过程的时间敏感操作研究。

papers.title: Detecting Is Not Choosing: What a World Model Needs to Keep a VLA Policy Safe
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies complete most benchmark tasks but often violate safety constraints. Since they are stochastic, one remedy is to sample several candidate action chunks and execute one that a world model predicts is safe. We ask what such a model must do. In simulation, a lookahead safety filter with the simulator as an exact world model raises the safety rate of three VLA policies on LIBERO and of pi0.5 on LIBERO-Plus by 11.5 to 25.7 points. It also helps pi0.5 on three RoboCasa tasks. Learned critics trained on one policy's data detect dangerous states (pooled AUROC up to 0.864) but rank candidates at one state close to chance (within-decision AUROC 0.551-0.560), and the learned dynamics and video models we test do no better. When the simulator's state is perturbed, selection degrades long before detection. In the loop, a median position error of 3.18 mm removes 70% of the gain on LIBERO-Spatial, partly because the error also corrupts the displacement check. On LIBERO-10 the loss is smaller, and the intervals overlap. The median does not predict the cost: a pixel reader with a 0.56 mm median error keeps 6.5 points less of the gain than Gaussian error of a similar median. A world model for safety should thus be judged by within-state ranking, and its state must be accurate in the tail and on handled objects, not only in the median.

ai_summary.problem: VLA 策略虽然能完成大多数基准任务，却经常违反安全约束。一种补救办法是用世界模型对采样出的多个候选动作块做前瞻式安全筛选，但这类世界模型究竟需要具备什么能力尚不明确。
ai_summary.method: 论文把仿真器当作精确世界模型，构建前瞻式安全过滤器，在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboCasa 上测试三个 VLA 策略以及 pi0.5；同时对比学习式 critic、学习动力学模型与视频模型，并区分“状态级危险检测”（pooled AUROC）与“同一状态下的候选排序”（within-decision AUROC）两种评测方式。作者还系统地扰动仿真器状态，考察选择性能随状态误差的退化规律。
ai_summary.result: 以仿真器作为精确世界模型时，安全率提升 11.5–25.7 个百分点；但学习式 critic 虽能检测危险状态（pooled AUROC 最高 0.864），在同一状态内对候选动作排序时却接近随机（within-decision AUROC 0.551–0.560），学习动力学模型与视频模型也无改善。状态一旦被扰动，选择性能远早于检测性能退化：3.18 mm 中位位置误差就抹掉 LIBERO-Spatial 上 70% 的收益；而中位误差仅 0.56 mm 的像素读取器反而比同等中位误差的高斯扰动少保留 6.5 个点，说明尾部误差与操作物体上的精度才是关键。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次明确指出“检测危险”不等于“在候选间正确选择”，并提出应以同一状态内的候选排序能力、以及状态估计在尾部与操作物体上的精度来评判安全用世界模型。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型辅助的 VLA 安全部署提供了明确的评测准则与设计方向，提醒社区不能仅凭危险检测指标来判断世界模型是否可用于安全筛选。

papers.title: Inspect Before You Decide: Evidence-Guided Visual Search for Industrial Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential for industrial anomaly detection and understanding. However, reliably identifying subtle anomalies remains challenging, as existing approaches often struggle to acquire and verify fine-grained visual evidence beyond global observations. To address this challenge, we propose EVAD, an evidence-guided visual search framework that enables MLLMs to actively seek and examine diagnostically informative visual evidence for reliable anomaly reasoning. Specifically, EVAD begins with a global visual assessment to identify potentially anomalous regions for further inspection. Building upon this observation, we introduce a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-guided exploration strategy that progressively acquires visual evidence through two complementary operations: semantic refinement for fine-grained inspection and spatial expansion for contextual verification. The acquired evidence is subsequently evaluated and integrated to support more informed and reliable anomaly decisions. Extensive experiments across multiple industrial anomaly detection tasks demonstrate that EVAD achieves state-of-the-art performance in most evaluated settings, highlighting the effectiveness of active evidence exploration for fine-grained anomaly understanding and reasoning. The code will be publicly available upon publication.

ai_summary.problem: 现有多模态大模型在工业异常检测中往往只能依赖全局观察，难以获取并验证细粒度视觉证据，导致细微异常识别不可靠。
ai_summary.method: 提出 EVAD 证据引导视觉搜索框架：先进行全局视觉评估定位潜在异常区域，再用蒙特卡洛树搜索引导语义细化与空间扩展两类操作，逐步采集、评估并整合视觉证据以支持异常判断。
ai_summary.result: 在多个工业异常检测任务上，EVAD 在大多数评估设置中达到 state-of-the-art，验证了主动证据探索对细粒度异常理解与推理的有效性。
ai_summary.novelty: 将 MCTS 引导的主动视觉证据搜索引入 MLLM 工业异常检测，通过语义细化与空间扩展协同获取可验证的细粒度证据。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型在工业质检等高风险场景中的可解释、证据驱动异常推理提供了新范式。
ai_summary.org: 未提供

papers.title: CAR: Reducing Decoder Output Shift in Visual Token Pruning via Coverage Selection and Attention Reallocation
papers.abstract: Visual token pruning is an effective way to accelerate multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing methods degrade substantially under aggressive pruning, especially on visual grounding (VG). We analyze the sources of this degradation from the perspective of the output shift that pruning causes in decoder layers, and decompose this shift in closed form into two terms, an image summary error and an attention allocation error. The summary error stems from the loss of visual information, and the allocation error from the drop in the share of attention assigned to visual tokens. To reduce both errors, we propose CAR (Coverage selection and Attention Reallocation), a token pruning framework that restores attention share while maintaining information. Specifically, to minimize the summary error, whose upper bound tightens as the retained tokens better cover all visual tokens, our coverage selection retains tokens that are both salient and non-redundant, with saliency from encoder heads chosen by a label-free probe. To minimize the allocation error, our attention reallocation reassigns the attention of the discarded tokens to the retained ones through a closed-form logit bias. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B with $90\%$ of the visual tokens pruned, CAR retains $93.0\%$ of the unpruned accuracy on visual question answering (VQA) and $77.9\%$ on VG, against $26.5\%$ for the best existing method on VG; the logit bias alone raises the VG accuracy of existing methods by up to $24$ points. Experiments on multiple MLLMs across VQA, VG and video understanding show that CAR generalizes well and consistently outperforms existing methods.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型（MLLMs）中的视觉 token 剪枝在激进裁剪率下会导致严重的性能退化，尤其在视觉定位（VG）任务上，现有方法几乎失效。
ai_summary.method: 作者从解码器输出偏移的角度将剪枝带来的误差闭式分解为“图像摘要误差”和“注意力分配误差”两项，并提出 CAR 框架：一方面用无标签探针挑选编码器头的显著性，选择既显著又非冗余的 token 以更好地覆盖全部视觉 token（降低摘要误差），另一方面通过闭式 logit bias 把被丢弃 token 的注意力重新分配给保留 token（降低分配误差）。
ai_summary.result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上剪掉 90% 视觉 token 时，CAR 在 VQA 上保留 93.0% 的原始精度、在 VG 上保留 77.9%（现有最佳方法仅 26.5%）；仅 logit bias 一项即可让现有方法的 VG 精度提升最多 24 个点，并在多个 MLLM 的 VQA、VG 和视频理解任务上一致优于现有方法。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将剪枝导致的解码器输出偏移闭式拆解为摘要误差与分配误差，并据此分别设计覆盖式选择与基于闭式 logit bias 的注意力重分配。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型的高效推理提供了可解释的误差分析框架和即插即用的剪枝方案，显著缓解了激进剪枝下视觉定位能力的崩塌问题，可推动 MLLM 在实际部署中的加速。

papers.title: GraphSeer: Multimodal Knowledge Graph Relational Image Retrieval with MLLMs
papers.abstract: Multimodal knowledge graphs (MMKGs) store entities with photos and names and link them by facts. MMKG methods predict links between known entity IDs, and image retrievers, from CLIP to MLLM embedders, return entities that look like a query photo or match its description. Neither answers a common question about a new photo: which graph entity is related to the one shown, such as the team of a pictured player or the city of a landmark. We call this knowledge graph relational image retrieval (KRIR): given a photo and a natural-language relation, retrieve the related MMKG entity, which rarely resembles the photo, whether the depicted entity is in the graph (known) or not (unseen). We build three benchmarks from YAGO, Wikidata and in-the-wild OVEN photos. The task hides two hops: recognising which graph entity is shown, and recalling what it is connected to. GraphSeer bridges them inside one multimodal LLM: it links the photo to the graph, reads the facts of the best match, and retrieves with the hidden state at which the model is about to say the answer. An unseen entity has no facts of its own, but every candidate answer does, so a listwise verifier reads the other end of the graph: it re-ranks the top candidates by their facts and photos in one forward pass, and the facts matter far more than the photos. With Qwen3.5-27B, GraphSeer improves MRR on known entities by 24.2-70.0% over an MLLM embedder fine-tuned on the same data with the same budget. When it also fuses and verifies the embedder's candidates, it improves MRR on unseen entities by 12.5-25.6%, and on known entities it beats KG-completion models given the ground-truth entity ID.

ai_summary.problem: 现有 MMKG 链接预测只能在已知实体 ID 之间推断关系，图像检索（CLIP 到 MLLM embedder）只找外观或描述相似的实体，二者都无法回答“新照片中的实体与图中哪个实体相关”这一问题；论文将其定义为知识图谱关系图像检索（KRIR）。
ai_summary.method: GraphSeer 在单个多模态大模型内完成两步隐式推理：先将照片链接到图谱实体，读出最佳匹配实体的事实，再用模型“即将说出答案”位置的隐状态做检索；对图中未出现的新实体，用一个 listwise 验证器读取候选答案一端的事实与照片，在一次前向中对 top 候选重排序。
ai_summary.result: 在 YAGO、Wikidata 与真实场景 OVEN 照片构建的三个基准上，基于 Qwen3.5-27B 的 GraphSeer 对已知实体 MRR 相比同预算微调的 MLLM embedder 提升 24.2–70.0%；融合并验证 embedder 候选后，未见实体 MRR 提升 12.5–25.6%，已知实体上甚至超过给定真实实体 ID 的 KG 补全模型。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出 KRIR 新任务与三个基准，并用“隐状态检索 + 候选端事实验证”把 MMKG 关系推理统一进一个 MLLM。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态知识图谱与多模态大模型的结合提供了新的评测范式和可解释的检索式推理路径。

papers.title: Beyond Language Optimization: Enhancing Visual Representations for Radiology Report Generation
papers.abstract: Accurate chest X-ray radiology report generation (RRG) requires recognizing clinically relevant abnormalities and accurately describing them. Although Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves the clinical accuracy of generated reports, our analyses suggest limited improvements in visual representations for abnormality recognition. To address this limitation, we propose a selective regional visual distillation framework that enhances visual representations of challenging abnormalities while preserving existing visual capabilities. Specifically, we train a region-aware teacher with targeted supervision on challenging anatomical regions to acquire complementary visual knowledge. Rather than transferring all teacher features, we verify their utility through regional feature replacement and select only those that improve the original student's performance. We further introduce a Spatially Gated Residual Adapter (SGRA) to distill these verified features while minimizing interference with the student's existing visual representations. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray demonstrate improved clinical report accuracy and region-level abnormality recognition across different multimodal large language model backbones, while largely preserving performance on non-target findings.

ai_summary.problem: 胸部X光报告生成需要识别临床相关异常，但GRPO主要提升生成报告的语言/临床准确性，对异常识别所需的视觉表征改进有限。
ai_summary.method: 提出选择性区域视觉蒸馏框架：先用针对性监督训练关注困难解剖区域的区域感知教师模型，再通过区域特征替换验证教师特征是否有用，仅选择能提升学生模型性能的特征，并用空间门控残差适配器（SGRA）进行蒸馏以减少对原有视觉表征的干扰。
ai_summary.result: 在MIMIC-CXR和IU-Xray上，方法在不同多模态大模型骨干上提升了临床报告准确性和区域级异常识别，同时基本保持非目标发现上的性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是面向报告生成的选择性区域视觉蒸馏，通过特征效用验证和SGRA在增强困难异常视觉表征的同时抑制负迁移。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作提示多模态医学生成任务中除语言优化外，还需显式增强视觉表征，对医学多模态大模型和报告生成研究有参考价值。

papers.title: HandiVid: A High-Quality Dataset for Hand-Driven Interactive Video Generation
papers.abstract: Hand-driven egocentric interactive video generation aims to generate dynamic scenes with realistic interaction responses conditioned on hand movements and camera motion. However, existing egocentric video datasets struggle to provide scene diversity, meaningful hand-object interactions, and reliable motion annotations simultaneously. To address these limitations, we introduce HandiVid, a high-quality dataset comprising 200K curated and annotated egocentric interaction video clips for hand-driven interactive video generation. We develop a unified data processing pipeline that integrates public datasets, online videos and synthetic videos. Through video quality assessment, hand detection filtering, and multi-stage interaction validation using vision-language models (VLMs), we select high-quality video clips with meaningful hand-object interactions. Since 3D hand reconstruction relies on initial hand detections, we integrate SAM 3 into the hand detection pipeline to reduce missed detections and improve the completeness of 3D hand annotations. Each video clip is provided with high-quality hand renderings, camera trajectories, and interaction descriptions. Comprehensive dataset analysis and downstream video generation experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of HandiVid in terms of data diversity, annotation quality, and controllable video generation.

ai_summary.problem: 现有的自我中心（egocentric）视频数据集难以同时兼顾场景多样性、有意义的手-物交互以及可靠的相机与手部运动标注，导致手驱动的交互式视频生成缺乏高质量训练数据。
ai_summary.method: 作者构建了 HandiVid 数据集，包含 20 万个经过筛选和标注的自我中心交互视频片段；通过统一的处理流水线整合公开数据集、在线视频与合成视频，并利用视频质量评估、手部检测过滤以及基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的多阶段交互验证来筛选高质量片段；同时将 SAM 3 引入手部检测流程，以减少漏检并提升 3D 手部标注的完整性。每个片段均附带高质量手部渲染、相机轨迹和交互描述。
ai_summary.result: 全面的数据集分析以及下游视频生成实验表明，HandiVid 在数据多样性、标注质量和可控视频生成效果方面均表现有效。
ai_summary.novelty: 构建了首个面向手驱动交互式视频生成的大规模高质量自我中心数据集，并通过 VLM 多阶段验证与 SAM 3 增强的手部检测流水线，同时保证交互语义质量和 3D 手部标注完整性。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型与具身智能中的交互式视频生成、手-物交互建模提供了关键的数据基础设施，有助于推动可控、物理一致的自我中心视频生成研究。

papers.title: JKO-GRPO: Augmenting GRPO with Wasserstein Proximal Steps for Flow-Matching VLAs
papers.abstract: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $π_0,π_{0.5}$ generate continuous action chunks by flow matching, and online reinforcement learning (RL) can improve them beyond supervised fine-tuning. Existing methods, such as Flow-GRPO and $π_{\mathrm{RL}}$, optimize likelihood ratios of stochastic denoising transitions, which reweight the sampled actions by their advantages but do not use the distances between them. We propose JKO-GRPO, which augments Flow-GRPO with Wasserstein proximal steps, with two contributions: (1) At each state, we treat the group of sampled actions as an empirical distribution and formulate policy improvement as a Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) step. We use a soft discrete $c$-transform to construct transport targets from group-relative advantages and combine shared-noise regression of the deterministic flow sampler onto these targets and combined with the clipped Flow-GRPO objective without Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization. (2) We extend this approach to sequential VLA control through random-time branching: we select one or multiple action-chunk indices along old-policy trajectories and independently apply group-level JKO updates using candidate continuations from the corresponding states.

ai_summary.problem: 基于流匹配（flow matching）的 VLA 模型（如 π0、π0.5）在在线强化学习微调时，现有方法（Flow-GRPO、π_RL）只利用随机去噪转移的似然比，按优势对采样动作重新加权，却忽略了动作之间的距离信息。
ai_summary.method: 作者把每个状态下采样得到的一组动作看作经验分布，将策略改进建模为 Wasserstein 空间中的 JKO（Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto）近端步：用软离散 c-transform 依据组内相对优势构造传输目标，再把确定性流采样器在共享噪声下回归到这些目标，并与去掉 KL 正则的裁剪版 Flow-GRPO 目标结合。进一步通过“随机时间分支”扩展到序列 VLA 控制：沿旧策略轨迹选取一个或多个动作块索引，从对应状态生成候选续段并独立施加组级 JKO 更新。
ai_summary.result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值；作者主张该方法在保持 Flow-GRPO 优势加权机制的同时引入动作间的 Wasserstein 几何信息，并可在不依赖 KL 正则的情况下完成策略改进，且可推广到多步序列控制。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将 JKO/Wasserstein 近端步与 GRPO 风格的组相对优势结合，用于流匹配 VLA 的策略优化，并通过随机时间分支实现序列级更新。
ai_summary.relevance: 为扩散/流匹配类策略的在线强化学习提供了基于最优传输几何的新建模范式，对具身智能中 VLA 模型的 RL 后训练具有方法学参考价值。
ai_summary.org: 未在提供信息中标注；据作者 Guang Lin、Yikun Bai 的已知单位推测为普渡大学（Purdue University）

papers.title: SCRA-CLIP: Spherical-Contextual Representation Adaptation for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract: Recent advances in vision-language models have facilitated zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) through transferable visual-semantic representations. However, detecting fine-grained anomalies remains challenging due to inadequate modeling of diverse anomaly patterns and their spatial context. To address these challenges, we propose SCRA-CLIP, a Spherical-Contextual Representation Adaptation framework that jointly enhances anomaly-aware textual semantics and context-sensitive visual representations. Specifically, we introduce Spherical Prototype-Conditioned Prompting (SPCP), which employs von Mises--Fisher mixtures to model the directional distributions of normal and abnormal patch features. These state-specific prototypes are incorporated into textual contexts to guide the learning of more discriminative textual representations. Furthermore, we develop Context-Deviation Guided Visual Adaptation (CGVA), which captures local feature deviations relative to multi-scale neighborhood contexts and refines patch representations through adaptive gating. By integrating distribution-aware semantic modeling with context-sensitive visual adaptation, SCRA-CLIP facilitates more discriminative cross-modal matching for fine-grained anomaly detection and localization. Extensive experiments on 11 industrial and medical benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization capability of SCRA-CLIP across diverse unseen categories and domains. The code will be publicly available upon publication.

ai_summary.problem: 零样本异常检测中，现有视觉-语言模型对多样化异常模式及其空间上下文的建模不足，导致细粒度异常检测困难。
ai_summary.method: 提出 SCRA-CLIP 框架，联合增强异常感知文本语义与上下文敏感视觉表示。具体包括球面原型条件提示 SPCP，用 von Mises-Fisher 混合建模正常/异常 patch 特征方向分布并注入文本提示；以及上下文偏差引导视觉适应 CGVA，捕捉局部特征相对多尺度邻域上下文的偏差并通过自适应门控细化 patch 表示。
ai_summary.result: 在 11 个工业和医学基准上验证了有效性，并在多样未见类别和域上展现出泛化能力。
ai_summary.novelty: 将球面原型条件提示与上下文偏差引导的视觉适应相结合，实现分布感知语义建模和上下文敏感视觉表示的联合适配。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动视觉-语言模型在零样本异常检测与定位中的细粒度跨模态匹配能力。

papers.title: Seeing Beyond Names: Image-Grounded Concept Linking for Robust Vision-Language Recognition
papers.abstract: A zero-shot vision-language classifier is highly sensitive to the class names it receives. Even when images remain unchanged, replacing familiar labels with synonyms, abbreviations, or ontology terms can significantly alter predictions. We investigate this \emph{vocabulary shift} using a leakage-free evaluation protocol across Tiny ImageNet, ImageNet-R, ImageNet-A, and ImageNetV2. With CLIP ViT-B/16, alternative class names reduce top-1 accuracy by $14.8$--$17.6$ percentage points. To address this issue, we propose \emph{image-grounded concept linking}, a training-free method that maps class names to visual concepts and uses a reliability gate to improve predictions. The method outperforms a template ensemble across all four datasets, achieving a pooled gain of $1.8$ points. We further evaluate five vision-language backbones across four datasets. Our method improves performance in $16$ of $20$ backbone--dataset combinations, with no significantly negative results. It also reduces pooled negative log-likelihood across all five backbones. Stronger text linking and transductive refinement provide no consistent improvements, suggesting that accurate visual class-name linking remains the main challenge. A second CLIP ViT-B/16 seed confirms the improvement on ImageNetV2, but not on ImageNet-A.

ai_summary.problem: 零样本视觉-语言分类器对类别名称高度敏感：即使图像不变，仅替换为同义词、缩写或本体术语等，也会导致预测显著变化（CLIP ViT-B/16 top-1 下降14.8–17.6个百分点）。
ai_summary.method: 提出一种免训练的“图像 grounded 概念链接”方法，将类别名称映射到视觉概念，并用可靠性门控来改进预测；在Tiny ImageNet、ImageNet-R、ImageNet-A、ImageNetV2上评估，并测试五个视觉-语言骨干。
ai_summary.result: 方法在四个数据集上均优于模板集成，汇总提升1.8个点；在20个骨干-数据集组合中16个有提升且无显著负面结果，并降低五个骨干的汇总负对数似然；但第二个CLIP种子仅在ImageNetV2上确认提升，ImageNet-A上未确认。
ai_summary.novelty: 用免训练的图像 grounded 概念链接与可靠性门控来缓解类别名称词汇变化带来的零样本VLM性能退化。
ai_summary.relevance: 提醒并改善了视觉-语言模型对类别命名变化的鲁棒性，对零样本识别和VLM实际部署有参考价值。

key_lab_papers.title: Grounded in Contact: Reducing Floating and Interpenetration Artifacts with Multimodal Skill-Effect Models
key_lab_papers.abstract: Learning to predict the effects of contact-rich manipulation skills requires models that represent distinct outcome modes rather than a single expected result. Even for basic skills such as pushing, picking, and placing, small variations in contact conditions or object geometry can produce qualitatively different object motions under nearly identical states and actions. Deterministic and Gaussian models tend to average over these alternatives or represent them as a single broad distribution, obscuring distinct modes such as sliding, toppling, and rotating. We study probabilistic skill-effect models that learn multimodal distributions over object pose changes given partial point clouds and actions. We instantiate this abstraction with three representative model classes: mixture density networks, state tokenization, and flow matching, each paired with latent dynamics for next-step prediction. Across diverse objects and skills, explicitly multimodal models predict which outcome occurs more accurately than deterministic and Gaussian baselines. In planning, flow matching significantly improves task success over the deterministic baseline on every skill and achieves the highest success on every multi-step sequence. On a real robot, probabilistic models succeed at pick about twice as often as the deterministic baseline, providing evidence that probabilistic skill effects offer a practical abstraction for reasoning and planning under uncertainty.

ai_summary.problem: 在接触丰富的操作技能（推、抓、放）中，几乎相同的状态和动作会因微小接触条件或几何差异产生定性不同的结果（滑动、倾倒、旋转），而确定性模型和高斯模型会把这些多模态结果平均掉或抹平为单一宽分布，导致预测与规划失真。
ai_summary.method: 论文研究概率化的“技能效果模型”：以部分点云和动作为输入，学习物体位姿变化的多模态分布，并实例化三类代表性模型——混合密度网络（MDN）、状态 tokenization、flow matching，各自与隐动力学模型配对用于下一步预测，进而在规划与真机中评估。
ai_summary.result: 显式多模态模型在多种物体和技能上比确定性/高斯基线更准确地预测实际发生的结果模式；规划中 flow matching 在每个技能上都显著优于确定性基线，并在所有多步序列任务上取得最高成功率；真机抓取成功率约为确定性基线的两倍。
ai_summary.novelty: 系统对比三类多模态技能效果建模方式并与隐动力学结合，用实验证明显式多模态建模能在接触丰富操作中有效抑制漂浮/穿透类伪影并支撑不确定性下的推理与规划。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能中接触不确定性建模与基于模型的规划提供了可用的抽象与实证依据，对机器人世界模型研究具有参考价值。
ai_summary.org: 元数据未给出机构信息；作者含 Tucker Hermans（通常隶属犹他大学，并兼任 NVIDIA），具体以论文原文为准。

daily_insight.hot_topics: 今日 20 篇论文由多模态（约 18 篇）与世界模型（5 篇）两大主线主导，且高度集中在具身智能、VLA 与机器人操作场景。研究重心明显从“模型能力”转向“可靠性与安全部署”：世界模型的规划空间几何对齐、不确定性校准与安全筛选（JEPA-Shield、Detecting Is Not Choosing），以及医学/工业 VLM 评估中的稳定错误模式与反事实敏感性成为共同关切。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: 今日仅 NVIDIA 一家大厂上榜（Grounded in Contact：多模态技能-效果建模，用于抑制接触丰富操作中的漂浮与穿透伪影），无第二家大厂出现同方向论文，因此不存在大厂间的直接方法竞争。NVIDIA 该工作与当日世界模型、具身规划主线形成互补关系：其显式接触与技能效果建模可为世界模型的预测、安全 shielding 与候选动作排序提供更可靠的底层动力学输入，而非路线之争。
daily_insight.signals: 值得关注的信号：一是世界模型相关论文集体转向安全与不确定性（conformal 校准 + shielding、候选排序而非单纯“危险检测”），显示该方向正从预测精度竞赛进入“可验证、可部署”阶段；二是 S1Arena-MM 系统比较 System-1 小模型与 MLLM 的多模态决策分工，提示“哪些决策不必交给大模型”的推理成本议题正在成形；三是评估方法论普遍转向反事实与行为结构（医学 VLM、VLA 表征对齐），静态基准的可信度正被重新审视。
